label: caiso 72 hydro envelope
definition: (PROBE) caiso-72: measured hydro deliverability envelope — caiso-70 recipe + hydro_dispatch_envelope=True single delta (joint water fleet capped at the per-(month x hod) p95 of EIA-930 NG:WAT), 2023-2025. CT_PEAKER 1.40/1.23/0.87 TWh (caiso-70: 0.90/0.92/0.82; actual 4.56/5.24/3.09); evening model water lands on the measured level; 2023 spurious tail 540->473 h; LA_BASIN 2024 mean eases 47.65->47.19. C6 governance PASS + C8 PASS; C7 CT profile_r 0.78/0.77 vs 0.8 gate. See FINDING-caiso72-step0-evening-displacement-2026-07-10.
market_story: The envelope is a measured capability ceiling, not a floor: real hydro cannot hoard its monthly energy into the top evening hours (head/flow/min-flow scheduling), so the evening residual reality serves with gas/imports reappears in the model once water is bounded at its measured deliverability.
